issues.description: The problem statement and template expose PersonService methods (addParent, addChild, removeParent, removeChild) as public API to be implemented by students, and PersonResource invokes personService.addParent(...). However, in the solution PersonService.addParent(...) is declared private while PersonResource calls it. This visibility mismatch prevents PersonResource from compiling against the solution PersonService and contradicts the intended public service API students must implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the addParent method public in PersonService in the solution (and ensure addChild/removeParent/removeChild have the same public visibility as in the template/problem statement), so the service API matches the template and PersonResource usage. Alternatively, if the intent was to restrict visibility, update PersonResource and the problem statement to use the appropriate public service methods consistently.
